name: ManuScript
description: A dataset annotated with a novel taxonomy categorizing scholarly writing behaviors by intention, writer actions, and information types, designed to capture the end-to-end writing trajectory in scientific manuscripts. It aims to support writing assistants in providing structural and creative feedback on academic writing.
reputation: A specialized scholarly-writing annotation dataset with limited but useful adoption in research on writing assistants and academic text analysis.
notes: Provides a taxonomy and dataset for scholarly writing behavior analysis to improve academic writing assistance.
